verdicts.reason: A keeps good margins on the headline, but it breaks the original's centered stack: the subtitle is crammed into an awkward two-line wrap ('Now in four / flavours.') and pushed off-axis to the left of the CTA at the bottom, leaving a big dead gap under the headline.
